$doc.origin: Review items C6, C7 and C9.
$doc.invariant: A locked phrase joined into surrounding prose must not leave a structural seam: no duplicated imperative inside one clause, no coordinator binding a redundant second imperative, no repeated lead-in particle at the join, no repeated connective.
why_rendered: C7 is the reason this gate reads dist/ and never src/. The C6 fix verified clean in
plain source text and still left 326 defects on the page, because inline markup sits
INSIDE the join seam: `路况向向官方渠道核实` contains no duplicated
character until the tags are stripped. Any scan of source text for something a reader
sees is measuring the wrong artifact (methodology principle 5).
P36 confirmed this is not historical: the one live finding on the current corpus is
invisible in both the .mdx source and the raw HTML, and appears only after extraction.
why_rules_not_lists: Phase 3 of the P36 brief forbids encoding C9's 28 held shapes as an allow-list, and
the rules below do not contain them. C9 is expressed as a grammatical test instead:
a duplicated imperative is a defect only when a SURVIVING imperative preserves the
sentence. `都请向`/`务必请向`/`始终请向`/`也请向` carry exactly one imperative, so no
rule fires on them — the adverb modifies the imperative and cannot replace it.
`请A，请B` carries two, but a clause boundary separates them, so rule A does not fire.
New shapes obeying the same grammar are licensed automatically; new shapes breaking
it are caught without being enumerated first.

note: THE FIGURES ARE NO LONGER HERE (F5 Phase 5). They live in the phrase census, which
measured each once and records which extractor produced it. The zh core figure used
to be written twice — as `expected` here and as `count` in 4i-glossary.json — for one
measurement of one phrase by one extractor: defect D-1. Both gates now read the fact.
Carried forward because it is a lesson and not a number: the baselines were measured
on the RENDERED corpus at P36, never carried over from source figures. Source and
rendered counts of the zh core differ, and the rendered one is the one a reader sees.
Methodology principle 1 — a recorded size is a hypothesis about the measurement window.

clause_boundary_derivation: `、` is an enumeration comma and is NOT a clause boundary (C7 trap 1); treating it as
one hides real seams. ASCII parentheses hold inline phone numbers and are likewise
not boundaries — `预订前请拨打(435)219-9447请向官方渠道核实` is a genuine double
imperative, not a licensed coordinate pair.
`——` IS a boundary. Measured at P36: excluding it produces 8 false positives on
sentences carrying two genuinely separate requests (`都请向官方渠道核实——夏季请尽早预订`).
bound_morphemes: Methodology principle 7. `请` is a bound morpheme in 申请/邀请/聘请/请求 and a plain
verb meaning `to hire` in `请向导`. These are masked before any imperative is counted,
so a compound cannot inflate a clause's imperative count. This is lexical data about
the language, not a list of historical defects. The rendered corpus contains 邀请 (3)
scope_boundary: This gate checks the SEAM at a lock boundary. It deliberately does not verify that the
lock itself is present, complete or undrifted — that is gate 4i (P37). It reports
conserved counts as advisory drift telemetry and never blocks on them, because a count
changes legitimately whenever a page is added or removed.

$doc: AR-1. Registered with NO locks, deliberately. 4h detects damage at the JOIN SEAM of a
locked phrase; Arabic has no locked sentence-level phrase yet, because the corpus that
would have produced one is a single pilot page. Declaring a lock here to make the entry
look populated would be config nothing measures — the F2 M-4 defect.
No "imperative" block either. The zh imperative rule is built on a detachable particle
(请) that can be duplicated at a seam. Arabic marks the imperative in the VERB STEM
itself (احجز, اطّلع), so there is no separable particle to duplicate and the zh rule has
no Arabic analogue. Whether Arabic has its own seam hazard — the proclitic و, the
definite article ال assimilating across a join — is an AR-2 question that needs a corpus
to answer. It is left open rather than guessed at.
script "arabic" is a new value for this gate. See AR1-gate-characterization.md G-3:
the connective regex branches on script === "latin" and otherwise falls through to the
CJK-shaped branch, which is wrong for Arabic. With no locks and no connectives declared,
that path is unreachable today; it must be resolved before Arabic locks are added.
